subject: Audition windows, demo fallback plan, and speaker calendar for Redwood Optimize webinar
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audition windows + demo fallback plan for Redwood Optimize webinar

Team —

We have two external demos confirmed for the Redwood Optimize webinar on 2027-04-20: MetricFlow (Jasmine) and QuantumCloud (Aaron). I want to lock down audition / tech-check windows and a clear demo fallback plan so we don't need last-minute pivots. Proposed items: 

1) Audition/tech-check windows (30m per speaker) — options:
   - Mon 2027-04-18: 9:00–12:00 PT (US morning block)
   - Tue 2027-04-19: 12:00–16:00 PT (catch APAC overlap)

2) Demo fallback options (pick A/B/C per partner):
   - A: Live demo using vendor-provided cloud instance (preferred)
   - B: Pre-recorded screen capture with local audio (uploaded to our staging drive)
   - C: Live demo via shared recording with on-stage host narrating (last resort)

3) Deliverables / deadlines:
   - Final slide deck + demo script: due 2027-04-14 EOD
   - Speaker bio + headshot: due 2027-04-12
   - Recording consent (DocuSign) — sent to external guests once slots confirmed

Attachments: speaker-bio-template.docx, slide-guidelines.pdf (see attached).

Please reply with which audition window you recommend I offer to each guest (I'll send invites), any technical constraints we should flag, and whether we need a dedicated staging host for each demo.

Connor

Agree with the windows. A couple of notes: 

- For MetricFlow (global customers in EU/APAC), offer Tue 2027-04-19 12:00–12:30 PT (works late evening for APAC folks).
- For QuantumCloud I recommend Mon 2027-04-18 10:00–10:30 PT. Aaron historically prefers morning slots.
- We should plan for a 10-minute dry run inside the audition where we validate: network access to vendor demo endpoint, token limits for any live models, and a fallback short script that the host can read if live fails.

Stephanie — can you confirm whether we need one staging host or two (vendor-by-vendor)? If one, Marissa/Connor can do the host handover.

Karthik

Thanks for the heads up. MetricFlow is available Tue 2027-04-19 12:00–12:30 PT for the tech check. A few constraints on our side: 

- The live demo relies on a secure demo cluster that requires an IP allowlist. Can you confirm whether Redwood staging IPs are ok? If not, we can switch to pre-recorded.
- Our presenter only has a 12-minute window during the webinar (tight), so if we go live we'll do a 6–7 minute demo + 3–4 minute Q&A.

About recording consent — please send the DocuSign link and we'll sign. Also, could you confirm the slide template format (.pptx is fine).

Good catch on the allowlist. Sam from EventTech (cc'd on the next update) will share our staging IP block; if MetricFlow can't add it in time, we'll pivot to pre-recorded. Notes and next steps: 

- Confirmed audition slots: 
  * MetricFlow — Tue 2027-04-19 12:00–12:30 PT (booked)
  * QuantumCloud — Mon 2027-04-18 10:00–10:30 PT (pending Aaron's OK)
- Jasmine: I'll send the DocuSign recording consent right after this thread.
- Slide format: .pptx preferred; use slide-guidelines.pdf for length/brand rules.
- Demo fallback plan we will publish to the staging doc with priority order: Live -> Pre-recorded -> Host-narrated replay. Connor will maintain the order in the run sheet.
- Dress rehearsal: request a 15m dress rehearsal 24 hours before the event (2027-04-19 for MetricFlow). Please confirm availability during the audition.

Attachments (for internal ops): speaker-bio-template.docx

Connor
